g.title: j2863704970
g.text: Bonjour, bonjour, mon cœur ! I have given it some thought, oui... and I am truly loath to admit it. It gives me no pleasure to say this.

g.title: j3987754223
g.text: Bonjour, bonjour ! I have given it some thought, oui... and I am truly loath to admit it. It gives me no pleasure to say this.

g.title: j3916149333
g.text: I think... the devil is growing on me. Like lichen.

g.title: j2591814240
g.text: S'il te plaît, make it stop - soon I will find myself laughing at his jokes. Then I will know I am truly lost !

g.title: j2188067330
g.text: Have you thought anymore about how to convince Loid to talk to the Entrati family upstairs?

g.title: j1992734845
g.text: I've been thinking about how to convince Loid to go up those stairs to finally talk to the family, and... I have an idea, but I don't think you'll like it.

g.title: j2484074520
g.text: Marie, are you still on board to... maybe try to convince Loid to talk to the "upstairs neighbors?" I know we left that off on a weird note.

g.title: j1959227478
g.text: On the subject of trying to get Loid and the Entrati family talking, I was... wondering if you've reconsidered Roathe's involvement at all?

g.title: j277280602
g.text: I have been thinking of how Monsieur Loid is so frightened of speaking to le Cardinal's family.

g.title: j2414740099
g.text: And how we must break this impasse. This purgatoire in which we are trapped should not stand. It seems so needlessly painful.

g.title: j3136824322
g.text: Bonjour mon cœur ! I have given it some thought... and I am truly loath to admit it. It gives me no pleasure to say this.

g.title: j4050060435
g.text: Bonjour ! I have given it some thought... And I am truly loathe to admit it. It gives me no pleasure to say this.

g.title: j2454704479
g.text: Bonjour, mon cœur ! And what are you afraid I will not like ?

g.title: j2324850311
g.text: Bonjour ! Oh ? And what are you afraid I will not like ?

g.title: j894703259
g.text: Bonjour, bonjour, mon cœur ! I have given it some thought... and I am truly loath to admit it. It gives me no pleasure to say this.

g.title: j1509157920
g.text: Bonjour - I have given it some thought... and I am truly loath to admit it. It gives me no pleasure to say this.

g.title: j575567590
g.text: But I feel as though we need... a bastion of some kind, non ? Do you have any ideas ?

g.title: j3230780562
g.text: But I think... I think - ah, Sol forgive me - that the devil's assistance may be required. I do not think Monsieur Loid will listen to us otherwise.

g.title: j1792158576
g.text: I think we might need Roathe's help to convince Loid to talk to the Entrati family. I don't think he'll do it otherwise. Without assurances that the family, and he, will be protected.

g.title: j2087056778
g.text: I believe you may be right. The devil may be the missing piece we need. Ah, it pains me even to type the words !

g.title: j855915289
g.text: I don't really have any good ideas that doesn't involve taking help from terrible sources. Sources that might just get us into deep trouble later. Namely, Roathe.

g.title: j982922696
g.text: The devil is powerful, and provides certain promises of strength should things go wrong, non ?

g.title: j2035575141
g.text: I... hate to admit it, but I think you may be right... Sol forgive me.

g.title: j2818157382
g.text: Are you so sure ? If I can set aside my différences with the devil, certainly so can you, non ?

g.title: j3082966535
g.text: You're right. I didn't think you'd agree to it. I was afraid to ask.

g.title: j2093488210
g.text: No, there has to be another way. I refuse to ask for his help on this.

g.title: j3157697569
g.text: Will he give us his aid in this regard ?

g.title: j1606464815
g.text: Will he give us his aid in this regard ?

g.title: j216004359
g.text: Will he give us his aid in this regard ?

g.title: j3363274699
g.text: Do you think you can convince him to help us, though ?

g.title: j2196304565
g.text: All right. If you're okay with it, I'll be okay with it.

g.title: j3769092663
g.text: No, unfortunately... I think that was a dead end with him. Do you think there's another way?

g.title: j668391906
g.text: He will. I've convinced him to help reunite them - and you won't believe this - I think it's so that he can help protect Entrati's family. They're all that really remains of the Orokin, after all.

g.title: j1048884772
g.text: He will. I've convinced him to help reunite them - and you won't be surprised by this - I think it's mostly to spite Albrecht in his absence.

g.title: j1155758424
g.text: I'm still working on it, but I think so.

g.title: j3548717784
g.text: Nothing is settled yet. He's... well, you know how he can be.

g.title: j2417208406
g.text: Oui, I do not have to enjoy it, but it is un médicament we must swallow, I suppose.

g.title: j1939224710
g.text: Oh ! That is... unfortunate. I do not know ? I do not think so... Can you think of another approach with the devil ? Or a way to try again ?

g.title: j513485404
g.text: He is helping to protect the family of the man who turned him into protoframe against his will, and cast him into the past, robbing him of his memories...

g.title: j2969054108
g.text: You are right, I am... not surprised.

g.title: j3033577955
g.text: Then I will support your choice, as well.

g.title: j1047121376
g.text: I will speak to Lyon in the meanwhile, but my hopes are exceedingly low.

g.title: j2835523914
g.text: I think it's just the excuse he's making to cover for it.

g.title: j2175991463
g.text: At least he'll help, though. And I'll make sure he doesn't actually follow through with his threats.

g.title: j4127843675
g.text: ฉันคิดว่าคุณมีวิธีโน้มน้าวใจเขาแบบพิเศษ ในแบบที่คนอื่นทำไม่ได้ non ?

g.title: j472476332
g.text: I wish you the best of luck. That devil can be obstinate at the best of times. Sometimes, I think he just enjoys being contrary !

g.title: j3665733766
g.text: Oui แต่ฉันคิดว่าคุณมีวิธีโน้มน้าวใจเขาแบบพิเศษ ในแบบที่คนอื่นทำไม่ได้ non ?

g.title: j4104405770
g.text: Oui, certainly I do. That devil can be obstinate at the best of times. Sometimes, I think he just enjoys being contrary !

g.title: j3344147004
g.text: I have deeply misjudged this devil of ours...

g.title: j1765421245
g.text: Oui, I hope you are correct.

g.title: j32599190
g.text: Oui. At least you are around to ensure we keep him from following through on his... baser instincts.

g.title: j946838374
g.text: I wouldn't want to use my relationship with him as a negotiation tool.

g.title: j302588066
g.text: He can be, but I think a lot of that is just for show.

g.title: j1068639330
g.text: I actually kind of enjoy it, as weird as it sounds. We get along.

g.title: j979139064
g.text: The devil is fickle ! C'est la vie, as they say !

g.title: j3767180544
g.text: And I am not a fool to not see the part you played in ensuring this all came to pass !

g.title: j2920833151
g.text: Oh ! That is not what I was implying, pardonne-moi ! Simply that he seems to favor you, so you may have his ear where all others he may ignore.

g.title: j297694120
g.text: Oui, he certainly does seem to favor you. Perhaps it is because you share a time and a place, where we do not ? Why else would he ?

g.title: j2932981948
g.text: I certainly have no idea what you mean ! I am not insinuating anything at all. I am a purely une innocente Sœur de Sol.

g.title: j3208239704
g.text: Well ! When the time comes, I will be ready and waiting ! Until then, merci, mon cœur.

g.title: j549463413
g.text: Well ! When the time comes, I will be ready and waiting ! Until then, merci.

g.title: j2545548783
g.text: I would never imply that since the devil seems to favor you, that perhaps he will listen to you where all others he seems to ignore.

g.title: j4102734153
g.text: I am simply happy that you are happy. And if the devil has somewhere to spend his... efforts... all the better, non ?

g.title: j842909493
g.text: Everyone in his life has tried to make him out to be some kind of monster. I suppose I'm the first person who hasn't.

g.title: j836580243
g.text: There's a lot about him that he just doesn't know how to show. It's not armor, per se - but he doesn't trust people not to hurt him.

g.title: j474805922
g.text: He's... had some real heartbreak in his many years. It's scabbed over with thorns, that's all.

g.title: j1162327759
g.text: I guess I can understand the amount of years he's lived. I've seen the same amount of death he has.

g.title: j919081835
g.text: He's only ever tried to do what was right. Maybe in the wrong way, sure - but he was trying to save the Origin System from the Orokin.

g.title: j2342335592
g.text: I enjoy his wry sense of humor. He's clever, when you get past his ego.

g.title: j171133207
g.text: Well ! When the time comes, I will be ready and waiting ! Until then !

g.title: j2712407306
g.text: And never during private moments. Non. Jamais.

g.title: j2630814230
g.text: Even more so for us all if you serve as a bit of un ange upon his shoulder to temper him.

g.title: j1881593101
g.text: And I suppose I am atop that list of late, non ? I suppose I should... consider his reasons, for why he is the way he is. Condemnation saves no souls.

g.title: j1603881267
g.text: There is always a pain we hide from those around us. Something we seek to shelter, for fear others will wield it. I suppose I should strive to be kinder to him, if what you say is true.

g.title: j688488160
g.text: I cannot imagine the amount of love and loss one must suffer in all those years. It seems so unreal, even given all that I have seen.

g.title: j2047602151
g.text: Sometimes I forget, when I speak to him, how many centuries he has lived. It seems so unreal, even given all that I have seen.

g.title: j2660064596
g.text: There are always... nuances, oui ? Always reasons for acting one way or another. I suppose I should strive to be kinder to him, if what you say is true.

g.title: j2618000579
g.text: No one has ever denied the devil his wit.

g.title: j1276527345
g.text: I never knew you had this side to you.

g.title: j653882434
g.text: Who says I'm trying to temper him?

g.title: j1781329024
g.text: Oui, what damage could that cause a soul ? I see why you would wish to find another who understood. And he, you.

g.title: j3613440902
g.text: To have lived so long, to have seen so much death - to have paid so much of it yourself ?

g.title: j109003483
g.text: I am simply glad the devil has someone to speak with who might seek to temper him. Un ange upon his shoulder.

g.title: j2617418891
g.text: Oui, I fear there is a wickedness in him that cannot truly be cured. He enjoys it too much.

g.title: j1524002402
g.text: Perhaps you are right... what is un ange without son diable ? He reminds us all of what we should strive to avoid.

g.title: j104956296
g.text: Well ! If and when you convince the devil to aid us in our mission, I will be ready and waiting ! Until then !
